Name: Restuffed Plush and Futan (CP x AT)
Author: NeonixNeo
Description:
[b][size=5]Restuffed Plush and Futan[/size][/b]

This mod adds: 
* 17 futan bear turned to different animal variants
* 14 large futan bear turned to different animal variants
* 4 junimo plush variants to match the small ones
* 10 futan rabbit variants styled after the 10 cats and dogs
* retextures for the futan rabbit, plush bunny, and small junimo plushes


credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece]siamece[/url] for the header style



[b]Installation instructions[/b]
you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]
you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]alternative textures[/url]


mods in screenshots:
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20337?tab=files&file_id=163009][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20337]Molamole's Furniture Retexture
[/url]* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27122]Molamole's Wallpaper and Flooring textures[/url]

Thank you to anyone who's supported my stardew mods by downloading or updating them. you're all very precious to me!
